DATA SCIENTIST — JOB DESCRIPTION
Company: Northstar Analytics (fictional)
Location: Hybrid / Remote
Employment: Full-time
Role Summary
Northstar Analytics is seeking a Data Scientist to turn business data into reliable insights and predictive models. The
successful candidate will work with product, operations, and analytics teams to frame measurable problems, build
reproducible analyses, validate models, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Responsibilities
• Explore, clean, transform, and analyze structured datasets.
• Build and evaluate machine-learning models for classification, regression, and forecasting.
• Use Python and SQL for data preparation, analysis, and feature engineering.
• Apply statistical reasoning, experiment design, and appropriate evaluation metrics.
• Create clear visualizations and communicate results and limitations.
• Develop reproducible workflows; collaborate through Git and code review.
• Monitor data quality, model performance, and potential data drift.
Required qualifications
• Strong Python skills for data analysis and machine learning.
• Practical experience with pandas and NumPy.
• SQL skills for querying and joining relational data.
• Familiarity with scikit-learn or a comparable machine-learning library.
• Understanding of statistics, train/test splits, cross-validation, and model evaluation.
• Ability to explain analytical findings and model limitations.
Preferred qualifications
• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or another visualization tool.
• Experience with cloud data services or data pipelines.
• Familiarity with experiment tracking, model monitoring, or responsible AI practices.
Evaluation note
This is a synthetic evaluation job description created for testing only. It is not a real vacancy. Do not treat keyword
overlap or any computed score as a hiring decision.
